newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CompUSA raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CompUSA raised to buy.

text.p: Dain Bosworth said on Thursday it raised its rating on the shares of CompUSA Inc to buy from neutral and increased its fiscal 1998 estimates.

-- Analyst Dean Ramos said in a research note the company's fourth quarter earnings, which it reported Wednesday, were 20 percent above the consensus earnings, which suggested upside to earnings numbers going forward.
-- "CompUSA is the clear leader in microcomputer retailing with financial returns rivaling 'best of class' operators from other sectors," Ramos said.
-- Ramos boosted his 1998 earnings estimate to $1.21 per share from $1.15 per share.
